name: Sheriff's Office
desc1: This is a stark and harshly furnished room. There is nothing but a
desc2: plain wooden desk and two chairs here. A grim-looking soldier sits
desc3: behind the desk, ready to answer complaints and to listen to reported
desc4: crimes. To the east is the dungeon stairwell, and to the north, the
desc5: Sheriff's desk. You can exit to Guild street to the south.
